inputs.goal: Discover the Kubernetes cluster resources, deploy a MiniCluster of the same number of nodes and maximum cores available. Use the container ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023 and maximize the amg2023 figure of merit. You MUST maximize memory per CPU core. More cores are better. The trick to optimizing this is THREADING. You MUST force OpenMP and any math libraries to use only one thread per MPI rank. On example is setting OMP_NUM_THREADS to "1". You might also consider setting OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism to "cma" as a conservative builder will set to none. YOU MUST SLOWLY increase the problem size, one dimension at a time, by an increment no more than double the current to increase the FOM. A timeout may not require a smaller problem size but rather a different instance. An example run that worked is amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 1. If the run is successful, parse the log and get the FOM. If not, keep trying to deploy until it is fixed. Keep going until you deem optimized and return all FOMs you have parsed. You MUST NOT oversubscribe.

inputs.manifest:
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: flux-sample
spec:
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
  container:
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
  flux:
    arch: arm64
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  job:
    name: amg
    command: |
      export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
      export OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=cma
      flux submit --flags=waitable --label-io amg -problem 2 -n 64 64 64 -P 4 4 1

outputs.data:
GROUP:      flux-framework.org
KIND:       MiniCluster
VERSION:    v1alpha2

FIELD: spec <Object>


DESCRIPTION:
    MiniCluster is an HPC cluster in Kubernetes you can control
    Either to submit a single job (and go away) or for a persistent single- or
    multi- user cluster
    
FIELDS:
  archive	<Object>
    Archive to load or save

  backoffLimit	<integer>
    BackoffLimit is the number of retries for the job before failing

  cleanup	<boolean>
    Cleanup the pods and storage when the index broker pod is complete

  containers	<[]Object> -required-
    Containers is one or more containers to be created in a pod.
    There should only be one container to run flux with runFlux

  deadlineSeconds	<integer>
    Should the job be limited to a particular number of seconds?
    Approximately one year. This cannot be zero or job won't start

  flux	<Object>
    Flux options for the broker, shared across cluster

  interactive	<boolean>
    Run a single-user, interactive minicluster

  jobLabels	<map[string]string>
    Labels for the job

  logging	<Object>
    Logging modes determine the output you see in the job log

  maxSize	<integer>
    MaxSize (maximum number of pods to allow scaling to)

  minSize	<integer>
    MinSize (minimum number of pods that must be up for Flux)
    Note that this option does not edit the number of tasks,
    so a job could run with fewer (and then not start)

  network	<Object>
    A spec for exposing or defining the cluster headless service

  pod	<Object>
    Pod spec details

  services	<[]Object>
    Services are one or more service containers to bring up
    alongside the MiniCluster.

  shareProcessNamespace	<boolean>
    Share process namespace?

  size	<integer>
    Size (number of job pods to run, size of minicluster in pods)
    This is also the minimum number required to start Flux

  tasks	<integer>
    Total number of CPUs being run across entire cluster
